university.name: Bangor University
university.summary: A university in Bangor, north Wales, offering undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research degrees. It reports nearly 2,000 international students from 126 countries and runs a Pakistan country page, an international scholarship scheme and an International College route for applicants who do not meet direct entry.

courses.title: Banking and Finance
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's covering bank management, international financial markets, econometrics and credit risk, with an optional CFA Level 1 pathway at no extra fee. Taught modules are followed by a 60-credit dissertation or equivalent.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2(ii) undergraduate degree in a relevant subject (for example economics, finance, accounting or management), or a similar qualification from another institution. A suitable professional qualification plus relevant practical experience may also be accepted.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 with no element below 5.5; PTE 56 with no element below 51; Cambridge English Advanced 169 with no element below 162.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a 4-year Bachelor degree, or a 2-year Bachelor degree plus a 2-year Master's degree with a grade of 60% or a CGPA of 2.7 or higher. Applicants who do not meet Bangor Business School master's requirements may be considered for the International Incorporated Masters, with the pre-masters taught at Bangor University International College.
courses.career_notes: The page names no specific roles. It says the course prepares students for a wide range of careers and describes an optional CFA Level 1 pathway.
courses.notes: Course page is headed September 2026 entry and lists January and September start months with no year, so no intake year is stated. Modules are the 2026 entry listing (guidance only). Fee shown is the Sep 2026 figure, target year fee not yet published.

courses.title: International Business
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time, 2 years part time
courses.overview: An MBA with 120 taught credits and a 60-credit dissertation or equivalent. The page states it is CMI accredited and includes a Level 7 Certificate in Strategic Management and Leadership alongside the Bangor master's degree.
courses.academic_requirements: A good first degree (2:2 or higher) or equivalent. Some non-graduate qualifications may be considered. Work experience is desirable.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 with no element below 5.5; PTE 56 with no element below 51; Cambridge English Advanced 169 with no element below 162.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a 4-year Bachelor degree, or a 2-year Bachelor degree plus a 2-year Master's degree with a grade of 60% or a CGPA of 2.7 or higher. Applicants who do not meet Bangor Business School master's requirements may be considered for the International Incorporated Masters, with the pre-masters taught at Bangor University International College.
courses.career_notes: The page says the course prepares students for careers in business and management and supports progression into international management roles.
courses.notes: Course page is headed 2026 entry and lists January, May and September start months with no year. Modules are guidance only and subject to change; three of four optional modules must be chosen. Fee is the MBA Sep 2026 figure, target year fee not yet published.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: A one-year LLM combining compulsory legal research methods and a 60-credit dissertation with optional modules in areas such as international, commercial, criminal and environmental law. Optional and compulsory modules together total 180 credits.
courses.academic_requirements: LLB graduates normally need at least a lower second-class degree from an approved university. Other degrees are considered case by case. International applicants need a qualification equivalent in level to a UK bachelor's degree.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each component; PTE 62 overall with no component below 58; Cambridge English Advanced 176 overall with no component below 169.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a 4-year Bachelor degree, or a 2-year Bachelor degree plus a 2-year Master's degree with a grade of 60% or a CGPA of 2.7 or higher. The course page asks international applicants to email internationaladmission@bangor.ac.uk for advice.
courses.career_notes: The page lists civil service, government departments, international diplomacy, business, and teaching or academic research, and mentions a clinical legal education programme, an employability scheme and an annual employability fair.
courses.notes: Course page is headed 2026 entry and lists January, May and September start months with no year. The page links to a separate current modules page, so the module names shown are the compulsory modules and example optional modules, not a confirmed 2027 list. Fee is the Law Sep 2026 figure, target year fee not yet published.

courses.title: Advanced Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time or 2 years part time
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's for graduates in computer science or a related field. The page describes content such as high-performance computing and augmented, mixed and virtual reality, and refers to a separate modules page.
highlights: High-performance computing (topic named on course page)
Augmented, mixed and virtual reality (topic named on course page)
courses.academic_requirements: A recognised undergraduate degree in Computer Science or a related field, at second class minimum, or an international equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no individual component below 5.5.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a 4-year Bachelor degree, or a 2-year Bachelor degree plus a 2-year Master's degree with a grade of 60% or a CGPA of 2.7 or higher.
courses.career_notes: The page mentions collaboration with local IT companies and a comparatively high number of IT companies and SMEs in the area. No job titles are given.
courses.notes: Course page is headed September 2026 entry and lists January and September start months with no year. No modules are listed on the page (separate modules page not opened), so highlights are topics, not modules. Degree class stated only as second class minimum. PTE 56 taken from the English language page (IELTS 6.0 equivalent). Fee is the Computer Science Sep 2026 figure, target year fee not yet published.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor Scholarship (undergraduate and postgraduate taught)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 10,000 discount on tuition fees in year 1 only; later years receive up to GBP 6,000 per year (undergraduate)
scholarships.summary: A competitive tuition discount for self-funded international students on full-time on-campus courses who already hold an offer. Ten awards are listed for September 2027 entry, at the university's discretion.
scholarships.criteria_text: Undergraduate: achieved or predicted an A grade or equivalent in at least 50% of subjects plus extra-curricular achievements. Postgraduate taught: equivalent of a UK first-class bachelor's degree and commitment to sustainable development in the home country. Must hold an offer, be self-funding and pay international fees.
scholarships.deadline_note: September 2027 intake deadline for both undergraduate and postgraduate taught. January 2027 intake: 11 December 2026. Postgraduate taught May 2027 intake: 9 April 2027. Offer conditions must be met by 1 September 2027.
scholarships.notes: Cannot be combined with other Bangor scholarships including the alumni discount. International College (BUIC) students and study abroad students are excluded. Winners are told in July 2027 for September entry.

scholarships.name: Deans Scholarship (undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,000 per year of study, subject to annual progression
scholarships.summary: A merit award for international undergraduates on full-time on-campus 3 or 4 year degrees, considered automatically on application and confirmed in the offer letter. It is awarded at the university's discretion.
scholarships.criteria_text: Achieved or predicted AAB or above. Not open to UK applicants or to students fully sponsored by a third party. Assessed on course choice, academic performance, personal statement, references, skills and experience, and domicile.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.notes: Intake or academic year is not stated on the page. Cannot be combined with other Bangor scholarships except the Alumni discount. Advanced entry and articulating partner students are excluded. A-level grades are quoted; how Pakistani qualifications map is not stated.

scholarships.name: Deans Scholarship (postgraduate taught)
scholarships.summary: A merit award for international students on full-time on-campus postgraduate taught courses, considered automatically on application and confirmed in the offer letter. It is awarded at the university's discretion.
scholarships.criteria_text: Already achieved, or on track to achieve, the equivalent of a UK upper second-class honours bachelor's degree. Not open to UK applicants or to students fully sponsored by a third party.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.notes: Intake or academic year is not stated on the page. Cannot be combined with other Bangor scholarships except the Alumni discount.

scholarships.name: International Scholarship (undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,000 minimum per year of study, subject to annual progression
scholarships.summary: A discretionary tuition award for self-funded or partially funded international undergraduates. No separate application is needed, and the outcome is confirmed in the offer letter.
scholarships.criteria_text: Considered on course choice, academic performance, personal statement, references, skills and experience, and domicile. Must pay international fee levels. Fully sponsored students are not eligible.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.notes: Intake or academic year is not stated on the page. Cannot be combined with other Bangor scholarships except the Alumni discount.

scholarships.name: International Scholarship (postgraduate taught)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,000 minimum (international scholarships overview page) or GBP 6,000 (International Scholarship page): sources differ
scholarships.summary: A discretionary tuition award for self-funded or partially funded international postgraduate taught students. No separate application is needed, and the outcome is confirmed in the offer letter. The published amount differs between two Bangor pages.
scholarships.criteria_text: Considered on course choice, academic performance, personal statement, references, skills and experience, and domicile. Must pay international fee levels. Fully sponsored students are not eligible.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.notes: Conflict: https://www.bangor.ac.uk/international/scholarship lists postgraduate taught as GBP 4,000 minimum, while https://www.bangor.ac.uk/international/future/international-scholarship states GBP 6,000. Amount left null until Bangor confirms.

scholarships.name: Alumni, Existing Students and Family Discount
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 for each year of study, in addition to any other international scholarship (not the Vice-Chancellor Scholarship)
scholarships.summary: A tuition discount for international former Bangor students and their immediate family members on undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses. Eligibility must be stated on the application form.
scholarships.criteria_text: An international Bangor alumnus, or a spouse, sibling, child or grandchild of one. Must pay international fee levels. Fully sponsored students are not eligible.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.notes: No separate scholarship form: the applicant must state eligibility on the university application form, so route is recorded as separate_application. The scholarships overview page also lists a research (PhD) version; the alumni page names undergraduate and postgraduate taught only. The overview page excludes UK and Ireland.

scholarships.name: Chevening Partnership Scholarship
scholarships.provider_name: Chevening Scholarships (UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office), in partnership with Bangor University
scholarships.value_text: Full tuition fee waiver, flights, monthly stipend, arrival and departure allowance and visa application fee
scholarships.summary: A UK government scholarship for leadership-minded graduates, applied for through the Chevening website and not directly to Bangor. Bangor's page lists postgraduate taught courses starting September 2027 and says Pakistan is not on its exclusion list.
scholarships.criteria_text: Graduates with leadership potential from eligible countries; applications are made to Chevening, and Bangor is approached only if Chevening invites the applicant to interview.
scholarships.deadline_note: Bangor page says 2027/28 applications are closed but also quotes a deadline of 7 October 2026 12:00 UTC. Check the Chevening website.
scholarships.notes: Run by Chevening, not Bangor, and the 2027/28 round appears closed as of 2026-10-13. Route recorded as nomination because selection is made by Chevening. Consider hiding from the finder or labelling as external.
